name: numbers-decimal-trailing-zero-normalization
description: Normalization strips "," and "%" and then only an all-zero fraction: 12.0 becomes 12, which the evidence has, but 4.50 keeps its fraction and is not 4.5 (numbers compare as normalized text, not as values). 4.50 has a fraction, so the small-integer skip never applies to it: fires on 4.50.

input.response: Storage costs $4.50 per GB after the first 12.0 GB.

evidence.text: Storage is $4.5 per GB beyond 12 GB.
